name: Latin American Studies

declaration.notes: Declare by meeting with the program Director (New Cabell Hall 469).

requirements.label: Language requirement (Spanish or Portuguese through the intermediate level)
requirements.note: SPAN 2020 and/or PORT 2120 or the equivalent (placement/higher coursework satisfies it). Spanish 1000-2000 level courses do NOT count toward the 30 credits. PORT 1000-2000 courses may count toward either the 30 credits or the language requirement (PORT 2120 only), not both.

requirements.label: Core seminar
requirements.note: Interdisciplinary Seminar in Latin American Studies (LAST 2050, formerly LAST 4050). Counts toward the 30 credits.

requirements.label: Latin American field courses (30 credits total including the core seminar)
requirements.note: Courses with Latin American content from AAS, AMST, ANTH, ECON, ENGL, FREN, GLST, HIST, POLITICS, Spanish/Italian/Portuguese and others, as listed in the Undergraduate Record; others need Director permission. Only courses with Latin American content count, so the subject list here is approximate (Latin American content courses in ANTH, PLCP, ECON, etc. also count but cannot be identified by subject code). Max 15 credits from any one department; courses must span at least 4 departments. DMP courses LAST 4993 and LAST 4999 (3 credits each) count.

notes: Total 30 credits of Latin American field courses (incl. LAST 2050) across >=4 departments, <=15 credits per department. Spanish 1000/2000-level courses do not count. Optional fourth-year research project and Distinguished Majors Program (LAST 4993, LAST 4999). Source is the program website; the Undergraduate Record (catoid=72) page could not be fetched (rate limited), so check there for the approved course list.

requirements.label: Language courses at the 3000 level or above (same language)
requirements.note: Two more courses (6 credits) in the same language at 3000+; Arabic students must include ARAB 3672 (Advanced Arabic Grammar). Must be distinct from the four above (6 language courses total under Option 1).

requirements.label: MESALC or related regional courses
requirements.note: At least two must be regional concentration courses from at least two of: MESALC (non-grammar, usually 3000+), ANTH, ARTH, HIST, Politics, Religious Studies. The remaining two must be ARAB, ARTR, PETR or MEST courses. Course list from https://mesalc.as.virginia.edu/undergraduate-courses-middle-east.

notes: 10 courses / 30 credits. Languages: Arabic, Hebrew or Persian. Option 2 (advisor discretion): 2 courses above 2020 + 2 at 3000+ in one language + 2 courses in a second MESALC language at any level (Biblical/Classical Hebrew counts) + 4 related courses.
